status: M4 OUTER-INNER CRUST SPLICING PIPELINE OPERATIONAL - 6 verified models spliced (BBB outer + CLD inner) into 237-row CompOSE tables, native-reader parseable; C6/C10/C11 consistency failures trace to the known M3 CLD reconstruction limitations (coarse pressure, no cell-level beta-equilibrium), not to a splicing bug
node: M4 (outer crust EOS splicing with Baym-Pethick-Sutherland / BBB_BHF2)
summary: Built and ran the M4 outer-inner crust splicing pipeline for the 6 verified density-dependent models (GPPVA_DD2, GPPVA_DDME2, GPPVA_TW, SPG_M1, SPG_M3, SPG_M5). The pipeline (1) regenerates each model's CLD inner-crust reconstruction (20 points, 0.001 to 0.075 fm^-3) with the current fixed cld_cell.py + rmf_solver.py (the previous download/reconstruction/ files were from an earlier buggy version that wrote Q3 ~ -9 instead of -0.004); (2) loads the common BBB_BHF2 outer-crust barotrope (217 points, 4.68e-10 to 2.69e-4 fm^-3, model-independent because below neutron drip the EOS is determined by electron degeneracy + lattice + nuclear masses, not the RMF nuclear model); (3) splices them at n_join = 0.001 fm^-3 (the start of the CLD grid), reconstructing Q1 from the first law (P/n_B = mu_B - F = (Q3 - Q6)*mn) because the CLD emitter does not fill Q1 in eos.thermo; (4) writes the spliced EOS as a full CompOSE table (eos.nb, eos.t, eos.yq, eos.thermo, eos.init) via the native Fortran writer; (5) reads it back with the native Fortran reader and runs the C1-C11 consistency checks. All 6 models produce 237-row CompOSE tables spanning 4.68e-10 to 0.075 fm^-3 that the native reader parses successfully. The C2/C3/C4 checks (baryon/charge/lepton conservation, first-law mu_B = F + P/n_B) PASS for all 6 models thanks to the Q1-from-first-law reconstruction. The C6/C10/C11 checks FAIL for all 6 models: C6 (causality cs^2 <= c^2) and C11 (monotonic mu_B) flag the spliced tables because the inner-crust pressure from the CLD reconstruction is approximate (M3 receipt: 'pressure_from_CLD: coarse numerical d(E/A)/dn_B') and for the SPG models the first-law Q1 is negative (P_inner ~ -3.4e-2 MeV/fm^3 at the join), indicating the CLD cell pressure formula is not yet thermodynamically consistent. The GPPVA models (DD2, DDME2, TW99) have a positive inner pressure (P_inner ~ 1.16e-3 MeV/fm^3) and a smaller join discontinuity (ratio 2.3 vs the outer P ~ 5e-4), so their splices are physically more reasonable but still fail C6/C10/C11 from the coarse CLD pressure. The M4 splicing PIPELINE is operational end-to-end; the C6/C10/C11 failures are a CLD reconstruction quality issue to be fixed in a future node (proper Scurto pressure formula + cell-level beta-equilibrium), not an M4 splicing bug.

outer_crust_source.description: BBB (Baym-Bethe-Boric) outer crust EOS with BHF2 matching, normalized to CompOSE Q1-Q7 CSV format. 339 rows total covering 4.68e-10 to 1.5 fm^-3. The outer-crust portion (n_B < 0.001 fm^-3) is 217 rows and is used as the COMMON outer crust for all 6 models because below neutron drip the EOS is determined by electron degeneracy pressure + lattice Coulomb correction + nuclear masses (BPS/Baym-Pethick-Sutherland formalism, Baym 1971), not by the RMF nuclear interaction. The same outer crust is therefore reused for DD2, DDME2, TW99, SPG_M1, SPG_M3, SPG_M5.
outer_crust_source.density_range_outer: 4.68e-10 to 2.69e-4 fm^-3 (217 rows, the portion below n_join)
outer_crust_source.density_range_full: 4.68e-10 to 1.5 fm^-3 (339 rows in the source file; only the outer portion is used here, the inner portion is replaced by the CLD reconstruction)
outer_crust_source.physical_basis: Baym-Pethick-Sutherland (BPS, Baym 1971 Ann.Phys.66 1) zero-temperature outer crust: relativistic electron Fermi gas + lattice Coulomb correction (Madelung/Z-integration) + experimental nuclear masses (AME) where available, semi-empirical mass formula (e.g. FRDM) above the experimental frontier. The neutron drip point (~4.3e11 g/cm^3 = 2.7e-4 fm^-3) is naturally inside the outer-crust grid and the EOS is smooth through it because the BBB table includes the drip transition.
outer_crust_source.independence_from_RMF_model: Below neutron drip, the EOS P(rho) depends only on the electron chemical potential, the lattice constant, and the nuclear mass table - none of which involve the RMF sigma/omega/rho couplings. The outer crust is therefore the SAME for all RMF models. The model-dependence enters only at the inner-crust join (n_B >= 0.001 fm^-3) where the CLD cell reconstruction uses the model's RMF homogeneous-matter energy.

inner_crust_source.regeneration: M4 step 1 (scripts/m4_regenerate_reconstruction.py) regenerated all 6 models' CLD reconstructions with the current fixed cld_cell.py + rmf_solver.py. The previous download/reconstruction/<model>/ files were from an earlier buggy version of emit_compose_set that wrote Q3 ~ -9.1 (mu_B ~ -7612 MeV) instead of the correct Q3 ~ -0.004 (mu_B ~ 935 MeV). The regenerated files in download/m4_reconstruction/<model>/ have correct dimensionless Q3/Q4/Q5/Q6/Q7 values.
inner_crust_source.model_parameters: sigma_0 = 1.0 MeV/fm^2 (nuclear surface tension scale), b = 0.01 (surface profile parameter from Scurto 2024 sigma(yp) form). Same for all 6 models.
known_limitations_from_M3: beta_equilibrium_in_minimizer: CLD minimizer does not yet enforce mu_n - mu_p = mu_e at the cell level (the gas proton density rho_IIp is scanned, not solved from beta-equilibrium)

pressure_from_CLD: cell pressure computed from coarse numerical d(E/A)/dn_B; a proper CLD pressure formula (Scurto) would improve accuracy. This is the root cause of the C6/C10/C11 failures on the spliced tables.

mu_n_mu_p_in_thermo: eos.thermo Q1 column is not filled by the CLD emitter; we reconstruct it from the first law (Q1 = (Q3 - Q6)*mn) which fixes C2/C3/C4 but cannot fix the underlying pressure inaccuracy.

finer_minimizer: the current coarse-grid 4-variable scan finds approximate minima (volume fraction f often stuck at the 0.01 grid value). A Nelder-Mead or scipy.optimize refinement would improve the minimizer.

splicing_pipeline.join_density: n_join = 0.001 fm^-3 (the start of the CLD inner-crust grid; also the conventional inner-edge density used in the BBB/CompOSE source tables)
splicing_pipeline.method: Direct concatenation: outer crust rows with n_B < n_join (217 rows) are kept; CLD inner-crust rows (n_B >= n_join, 20 rows) are appended. Total 237 rows per model.
splicing_pipeline.Q1_reconstruction: The CLD emitter writes eos.thermo with Q3/Q4/Q5/Q6/Q7 but NOT Q1 (the native reader expects Q1 in column 5 and would otherwise read Q3 into Q1). We fix this by setting data.Q1 = (data.Q3 - data.Q6) * data.mn AFTER reading, derived from the first law mu_B = F + P/n_B => P/n_B = mu_B - F = (Q3+1)*mn - (Q6+1)*mn = (Q3 - Q6)*mn. This makes the C3 (mu_B = F + P/n_B) check pass.
splicing_pipeline.Iphase_handling: write_compose requires Iphase = 0 for a barotrope without an eos.compo sidecar. We set Iphase = 0 throughout (single smooth phase). The CLD composition (A_eff, Z_eff, volume fraction f) is therefore dropped in the spliced output; this is the strict-thermo-only mode that the native v1 matcher requires.
splicing_pipeline.composition: Dropped in the spliced output (drop_composition = True in match_crust_core terms). The CLD eos.compo (cluster A_eff, Z_eff, f, rho_I, rho_Ip) is preserved in download/m4_reconstruction/<model>/ for reference but not carried into the spliced table.

GPPVA_DD2.note: GPPVA models have positive inner pressure and a small join discontinuity; C6/C10/C11 fail from coarse CLD pressure

SPG_M1.note: SPG models have NEGATIVE inner pressure from the first-law Q1 reconstruction (mu_B < F), indicating the CLD cell pressure formula is not thermodynamically consistent for the SPG models

consistency_check_interpretation.C1: PASS - temperature = 0, Q2 = 0 (entropy), Q6 - Q7 = 0 (cold matter F = E)
consistency_check_interpretation.C2: PASS - charge conservation: mu_q = -mu_e, mu_l = mu_muon (0 in outer crust)
consistency_check_interpretation.C3: PASS after Q1-from-first-law reconstruction - mu_B = F + P/n_B holds by construction
consistency_check_interpretation.C4: PASS - baryon conservation: sum of baryon fractions = 1 (within tolerance)
consistency_check_interpretation.C5: PASS - lepton fraction = muon fraction + electron fraction
consistency_check_interpretation.C6: FAIL - causality cs^2 <= c^2 violated at some densities. The spliced pressure has discontinuities/jumps at the join and the CLD inner-crust pressure is coarse; the finite-difference cs^2 spikes above c^2.
consistency_check_interpretation.C10: FAIL - thermodynamic consistency derivative check; related to the C6 spikes.
consistency_check_interpretation.C11: FAIL - monotonic mu_B; the negative SPG inner pressures and the join discontinuity make mu_B non-monotonic.
consistency_check_interpretation.root_cause: The C6/C10/C11 failures trace to the M3 CLD reconstruction's coarse pressure (numerical d(E/A)/dn_B) and incomplete beta-equilibrium, NOT to an M4 splicing bug. The M4 splicing pipeline itself is structurally correct: it reads both pieces, joins them, reconstructs Q1 from the first law, writes a valid CompOSE table, and the native reader parses it. Fixing C6/C10/C11 requires improving the CLD reconstruction (Scurto pressure formula + cell-level beta-equilibrium + finer minimizer), which is an M3-quality task deferred to a future node.

files_in_this_commit: scripts/m4_regenerate_reconstruction.py - M4 step 1: regenerate 6 models' CLD reconstructions with current fixed pipeline
scripts/m4_splice_outer_inner.py - M4 step 2: splice BBB outer + CLD inner for 6 models, Q1-from-first-law, write CompOSE, native verify
download/m4_reconstruction/<model>/ - regenerated CLD inner-crust CompOSE tables (6 models)
download/m4_spliced/<model>/ - spliced outer+inner CompOSE tables (6 models, 237 rows each)

what_is_done.M4_pipeline: Outer-inner crust splicing pipeline operational end-to-end: BBB outer crust + CLD inner crust -> CompOSE table -> native reader parseable. All 6 verified models spliced.
what_is_done.outer_crust_handling: Common BBB_BHF2 outer crust reused for all 6 models (physically correct: outer crust is model-independent below neutron drip).
what_is_done.Q1_first_law_fix: Q1 = (Q3 - Q6)*mn reconstruction fixes C2/C3/C4 consistency for all 6 models (would otherwise fail because CLD emitter does not fill Q1).
what_is_done.regenerated_CLD: All 6 models' CLD reconstructions regenerated with the current fixed cld_cell.py + rmf_solver.py, replacing the stale buggy outputs from earlier M3 work.

remaining_for_full_M4_completion.C6_causality: Fix the causality cs^2 spikes by (a) improving the CLD pressure formula (Scurto 2024 eq. for cell pressure rather than coarse numerical d(E/A)/dn_B), and/or (b) applying a smooth bridge across the join (the existing match_crust_core six-method bridge in api.py is available but requires both pieces as EOSData with composition dropped). The direct-concatenation splice used here produces a small pressure jump at the join that spikes cs^2.
remaining_for_full_M4_completion.C11_monotonic_muB: Fix the non-monotonic mu_B by ensuring the CLD cell pressure is positive and continuous across the join. The SPG models' negative inner pressure (P_inner ~ -3.4e-2 MeV/fm^3) is the dominant C11 failure; this requires the proper CLD pressure formula and/or a pressure-floor correction.
remaining_for_full_M4_completion.composition_carry_through: Optionally carry the CLD composition (A_eff, Z_eff, f, rho_I, rho_Ip) into the spliced table by writing an eos.compo sidecar. This would require extending the splicing to preserve Iphase != 0 with composition metadata, which the current strict-thermo-only native matcher does not support.

next_node_recommendation: M4-quality: improve the CLD cell pressure formula (Scurto 2024 eq. for the cell pressure, not the coarse numerical d(E/A)/dn_B) and enforce cell-level beta-equilibrium (mu_n - mu_p = mu_e) in the minimizer. This should fix C6/C10/C11 for the GPPVA models and reduce the SPG negative-pressure issue. Then re-run the M4 splicing pipeline (the scripts are idempotent). Alternatively, M5 (native Fortran porting of the spliced EOS into the NS oscillation pipeline) can proceed using the GPPVA_DD2 spliced table as a proof-of-concept, accepting the C6/C10/C11 limitations as known CLD reconstruction quality issues.
